Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.videoconference

Interface P2pSideChannel.Listener

Enclosing class:
P2pSideChannel
public static interface P2pSideChannel.Listener
The event sink for the side-channel. Callbacks arrive on the transport's I/O thread, never the EDT, so a Swing caller must marshal before touching a widget. Every method has an empty default so a partial sink stays terse.
